thread:
julia_sales: FYI StratoLabs just pinged — POC running in their VPC (us-central) is showing 30-40% slower embeddings throughput after ~90m. CTO wants an exec touchpoint if we can't stabilize within 3 hours. Can @sam_se summarize the test and errors? :eyes:
sam_se: Running private package on 3x H100s (dedicated). Workload = dense embedding streams (batch=128) + occasional long-chat fallbacks. Repro: sustained job drops from 4800 embeds/s -> ~3000 embeds/s. Tail latency jumps to ~700ms. No obvious error in our app layer. Posting short logs.
sam_se: log lines:
```
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z runtime: kvcache eviction ratio=0.31 threshold=0.1
2026-03-20T09:12:04Z network: tls handshake retry for kms-host=kmsp-vpc.strato
2026-03-20T09:12:06Z runtime: enqueue batch size=128 latency=22ms
```
leo_runtime: kvcache eviction that high suggests our prefix caching policy is thrashing with embedding churn. But TLS retries to KMS are worrying 14 could block tokenization pipeline. I'll check kernel and runtime metrics.
tara_infra: Which image/kernel? If KMS endpoint is tunneled through customer firewall, we might be seeing intermittent resets. Also confirm that host drivers on their AMI match our validated stack.
sam_se: Image is rwi-private-2026-03-01-h100. Strato uses an inline TLS proxy on their edge appliance. They confirmed some recent patches on the appliance.
omar_security: Strato's security team asked for a clear diagram of where keys are decrypted and whether any plaintext cache touches host memory outside the enclave. I'll draft a short note but need exact pipeline path.
ben_support: Quick workaround: we can re-route KMS calls to our hosted KMS relay temporarily (with customer's approval) so they don't go through their proxy. That will show if the proxy is the bottleneck. Also can reduce embedding batch sizes to avoid eviction thrash for the short term.
julia_sales: They prefer to keep keys in their control for the POC, but might accept a temporary hosted relay if we sign an interim risk acceptance. CTO is pushing for minimal changes. They also asked for an estimate of reserved capacity pricing if they go Prod with dedicated H100 pools.
leo_runtime: Short mitigation plan: (1) toggle caching policy to more conservative TTL for embeddings to limit evictions, (2) run small test with KMS relay to see handshake stability, (3) if TLS retries continue, collect TCPS metrics from host to show resets. I can roll config change in ~30m.
tara_infra: I'll open infra ticket INF-9334 and kick off a parity hosted cluster in us-central for fallback testing. Also pinging oncall infra.
deploy-bot: Job created by leo_runtime: emb-cache-conservative -> private-us-central -> apply. Status: running.
leo_runtime: After cache change: embedding throughput improved from 3000 -> 4400 embeds/s in quick-smoke (still slightly below baseline 4800). KMS relay test in progress.
sam_se: KMS relay smoke: TLS handshake success rate 99.98% to hosted-relay vs 98.2% to customer-proxy. Latency delta minimal. Looks like the proxy is intermittently dropping connections during bursts.
omar_security: Security note: if we use hosted relay we must get written approval and document key transit. I'll prepare a short ATO-style addendum for legal. Strato wants SOC2 + encryption flow diagram.
julia_sales: Action summary: leo -> cache toggle + perf smoke (30m), tara -> INF-9334 + hosted cluster spin (ETA 1h), sam -> coordinate KMS relay test & get logs, omar -> compliance note for hosted-relay fallback, ben -> runbook for fallback and batch-size recommendations. I'll tell Strato execs we'll try a hosted-relay test and report in 90m.
ben_support: ack :thumbsup:
tara_infra: INF-9334 opened and oncall notified. Hosted parity cluster ready in ~50m.
leo_runtime: Perf after hosted-relay + cache change: hosted baseline 4780 embeds/s, private post-mitigation 4650 embeds/s p95=210ms. Still within 5% of hosted baseline.
julia_sales: Great. Scheduling exec sync at 17:30 PT to present the numbers and a proposed path: short-term conservative cache + network remediation, then production reserved pricing. I'll update Strato and ask for written consent for hosted-relay if needed.
sam_se: Also flagging that if Strato updates their TLS proxy firmware we'll need a retest. I'll include that in the notes.
omar_security: Compliance packet sent to legal and Strato: SOC2 report + KMS flow diagram + retention policy.
julia_sales: Thanks team. Closing unless Strato finds new issues after the exec. Please post only short updates here so I can keep the thread tidy. :white_check_mark:
